one_line: Buddhist princess of Kannauj who survives courtly turmoil and chooses the path of the Dharma.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s, slender yet resilient build with a composed, dignified posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with warm medium-brown complexion, straight nose, softly defined jaw, large expressive brown anime-style eyes with slightly arched brows; a small tilaka mark at the centre of the forehead; default expression calm and reflective, with a gentle, knowing half-smile that can shift to firm resolve.
appearance.hair: Long, straight black hair parted in the middle, drawn back into a high, smooth bun at the back of the head; a narrow gold circlet with a small central lotus motif sits low on the forehead; a few thin side-locks frame the cheeks but never cover the eyes.
appearance.costume: She wears a 7th-century north Indian princess-turned-Buddhist ensemble: an ankle-length, saffron-ochre cotton sari with a simple woven border in muted maroon, wrapped in a modest nivi-style with deep, neat pleats and the pallu brought over the left shoulder and around the front to cover the torso; beneath, a long-sleeved fitted blouse in soft cream that fully covers her upper body; over this, a light, pale-cream shawl (uttariya) draped over both shoulders and falling evenly front and back, hinting at her later monastic leanings; jewellery is restrained—small round gold stud earrings, a single thin gold necklace with a tiny lotus pendant, and two slim gold bangles on each wrist; she is barefoot or in simple brown leather sandals, with a narrow maroon cloth girdle at the waist to subtlely suggest noble origin without ostentation.
appearance.signature: A simple dark-wood Buddhist palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a maroon cord, carried in her left hand or tucked under her arm, sometimes with a slender prayer bead strand looped around the cord.

ref_desc: Rajyashri is a late-20s, warm-brown–skinned princess with an oval face, large brown eyes, long black hair in a high bun under a gold lotus circlet, wearing a saffron-ochre sari with cream blouse and shawl, simple gold jewellery, and carrying a dark-wood palm-leaf Buddhist manuscript tied with maroon cord in saffron, maroon, cream and gold tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Rajyashri, a late-20s north Indian princess-turned-Buddhist from early 7th-century Kannauj: she has a warm medium-brown complexion, oval face, straight nose, large expressive brown eyes, and a calm, reflective default expression with a gentle half-smile; her long straight black hair is parted in the middle and gathered into a high smooth bun at the back of her head, framed by a few thin side-locks, and she wears a narrow gold circlet with a small central lotus motif low on her forehead. Dress her in an era-accurate, ankle-length saffron-ochre cotton sari with a simple muted maroon border, wrapped nivi-style with deep pleats and the pallu brought over the left shoulder and around the front to modestly cover her torso; underneath is a long-sleeved fitted cream blouse fully covering her upper body. Over this, add a light pale-cream uttariya shawl draped evenly over both shoulders and hanging front and back, evoking a restrained, devotional look. Give her minimal jewellery: small round gold stud earrings, a thin gold necklace with a tiny lotus pendant, and two slim gold bangles on each wrist; at her waist, a narrow maroon cloth girdle subtly marks her noble background. Put simple brown leather sandals on her feet or show her barefoot on a neutral ground. In her left hand or tucked under her arm she carries her signature prop, a dark-wood palm-leaf Buddhist manuscript bundle tied with a maroon cord, with a slender prayer bead strand looped around the cord. Keep the colour palette focused on saffron-ochre, muted maroon, cream, warm brown and gold, and present front, three-quarter, and side views to clearly show her hair bun, circlet, sari drape, shawl, jewellery and manuscript bundle consistently.
